_comment: Model IDs here are in THIS HOST's accepted form, which is not the bare API ID. This checkout routes through 9router (see ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL), which augments model names and requires the cc/ prefix and the [1m] context suffix; the bare `claude-sonnet-5` and the `sonnet` alias are both rejected in agent-def frontmatter here (verified 2026-08-10). Resolve your own host's accepted form before editing — see the bootstrap skill's Model tiers section. Non-Claude provider IDs (e.g. kimi/kimi-for-coding) use the gateway's own provider prefix instead of cc/ — that prefix is not the [1m]-suffixed Claude convention above.

haiku.for: narrow mechanical slices — single-file edits, corpus hygiene, tests written to a sibling standard
haiku.caution: 200K context (the smallest tier): sized for one phase-scoped dispatch, not for wide-context reads across a corpus. Escalate rather than truncate.

sonnet.for: the default implementer — work to an existing pattern or a written spec, where the judgment calls are already made

opus.for: escalation only — design work, cross-surface doctrine, anything with a real judgment call the spec does not already settle

kimi.for: work to a written spec with tight, testable ACs (non-default; adopted for narrower scope by TASK-0146 on one bake-off sample) — not for doctrine, design, or anything with an unsettled judgment call
kimi.caution: Dispatch via the agent definition's frontmatter pin only — the Agent tool's model parameter rejects non-Claude IDs. Tool use through 9router worked in TASK-0146 (0 tool errors over 21 calls), but that is one sample: confirm served= from the transcript on every dispatch.
